feature: Account security - the real artifacts/portal '/account-security' page (src/pages/account-security.tsx), part of #1595. This manifest covers #3529's own scope specifically: the Password card, wired to POST /api/auth/change-password (auth.ts:822-868), carried forward from the retired portal-v2 implementation (#1601). The rest of the page (MFA enrollment, sessions, login history, data rights) is covered by the sibling manifests listed below - not duplicated here.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the auth gate on the change-password route, all four of the route's own documented (status, error text) failure pairs (missing fields / too-short / incorrect current password / no-password-set), a real success round-trip asserting the real revokedOtherSessions count, and a real UI walk opening the Password card's inline form and submitting a wrong current password through the real DOM.
SIBLING MANIFESTS FOR THE SAME PAGE: test-manifests/portal/account-security-mfa-enrollment.json (#2995), test-manifests/portal/account-security-data-rights.json (#2996).

'NO PASSWORD SET FOR THIS ACCOUNT' (400, auth.ts:838) IS NOT COVERED HERE, AND WHY: it requires a real passwordless account (SSO-only, no passwordHash row) and no such testbed account exists in this DB today. Verified by code reading only (auth.ts:837-840's own guard) - same allowance the old #1601 portal-v2 manifest documented for this identical gap.

SUCCESS ROUND-TRIP IS RUN FOR REAL, THEN REVERTED IN THE SAME TAGGED BLOCK: CP4 actually changes TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD to a temporary password and asserts the real revokedOtherSessions count the route returns, then CP-CLEANUP/CP-CLEANUP2 log back in with the temp password and change it back to {{TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD}} so the shared testbed credential is never left altered for the next run. CP4 also revokes this same session's own refresh token (every OTHER session, per auth.ts:855) alongside every other session, which is why CP-CLEANUP re-logs in rather than reusing {{authToken}}.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use, user id 39).
UI login uses the real /login page (#2991), same pattern as account-security-mfa-enrollment.json - data-testid='login-email'/'login-password'/'login-submit'.
onlyTag=change-password-3529 (apiTests) and onlyTag=change-password-3529-ui (uiSteps) each run standalone with their own self-contained login block, matching this file's siblings' convention.

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build (2026-09-10): a real attempt was made (`shaneapp://runTest?file=account-security-change-password.json&onlyTag=change-password-3529`) against the running BuildConsole instance and returned 'manifest not found or unparseable' - BuildConsole's local instance resolves test-manifests/ against the dedicated dev-server checkout, which only receives this worktree's commits at BuildConsole's own end-of-build merge (Git #1371/#1372 worktree isolation) - the same structural gap #2995's and #2996's own manifests documented for their own builds. Verified instead by: a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) and a real `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal with this wiring added, plus direct reading of the route handler (auth.ts:820-868) confirming the four (status, error-text) pairs and the success shape this manifest asserts against. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once merged.

apiTests.name: AUTH-GATE-1 - POST /api/auth/change-password with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
CP-SETUP-LOGIN - self-contained login so onlyTag=change-password-3529 can run standalone.
CP1 - missing either field (auth.ts:826) - 400 with the route's own literal message.
CP2 - new password under 8 characters (auth.ts:831) - 400 with the route's own literal message.

json.error: Password must be at least 8 characters

apiTests.name: CP3 - current password incorrect (auth.ts:843) - 401 with the route's own literal message.
CP4 - real success round-trip: correct current password + a valid new password - 200, ok:true, and a real revokedOtherSessions count (auth.ts:855/862).

CP-CLEANUP - revert the testbed account's password back to TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD so this run doesn't leave the shared tenant's real credential changed for the next session. Re-logs in with the temp password first since CP4 revoked this very session's own refresh token along with every other session.
CP-CLEANUP2 - change back to the original TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD - confirms the revert itself round-tripped for real.

uiSteps.name: CP-UI-LOGIN1 - goto the real login page (#2991).
CP-UI-LOGIN2 - wait for the login form to hydrate.
CP-UI1 - open the change-password form (real toggle state, not a modal fixture).
CP-UI2 - the form's current-password field is present.
CP-UI3 - submit with a wrong current password (never mutates real state - the route rejects before any write).
CP-UI4 - the form surfaces the route's own real 'Current password is incorrect' text (auth.ts:843), not a generic failure banner.
